business_delta: From accepted A17, retain two explicit one-aircraft units, separate stations and their UnitGroup membership, the same 36-hour simulation, seed, support data and readiness. Replace the original two-aircraft group-owned BASIC-MISSION with one-aircraft MISSION-A assigned to TEACH-UNIT; append the same-duration one-aircraft MISSION-B assigned to TEACH-UNIT-2. Each unit owns its own fixed schedule at hour 8. Only MissionType, OperationProfile, Operations and ProblemDescription differ from A17.
prior_diagnostic: A separate sealed J07.var05 candidate with this input and group-rollup as an acceptance requirement failed independent review. Under the native report settings, selecting TEACH-GROUP returned no mission tables for unit-owned profiles; a group-owned A17 control did return a group row. This narrower contract is frozen before fresh native runs and makes no group-rollup claim.
pre_run_hypothesis: Two independent one-aircraft fixed missions are ordered at 7, launch at 8 and succeed at 10, leaving both aircraft ready. The all-unit fixed result should show 2 requested/started/succeeded missions, 4 requested/accomplished mission-hours and 4 requested/accomplished aircraft-hours. Each selected unit and each selected mission type should show one wave, 2 mission-hours and 2 aircraft-hours; corresponding pairs should sum to all-unit. System and Stock have 72 half-hour bins over 0–36, with two operating aircraft over 8–10 and no backorders. The group selector should have no mission result rows because no group-owned profile exists; the accepted A17 group-owned parent should have one group row with 4 aircraft-hours and no member-unit mission rows. Any mismatch is diagnostic, not acceptance.
report_method: Guarded report-only passes on sealed SXO with local derivatives of fingerprinted installed Default.sxs. Six MissionSettings table flags are changed from N to Y; report selectors choose all units, each unit, each mission type, and negative group views. Parent A17 SXO is reported with the same settings as a group-owned positive control. The installed settings file and GUI are untouched.
acceptance_requires: pinned accepted A17 parent, installed manual/dictionary and exact four-table source delta
fresh session-0 SSH import/export/calc/default report with host queue and GUI PID13340 guard
exact 15 business-table source roundtrip, zero conversion errors and sealed raw artifacts
two per-unit/per-type event and aircraft-hour ledgers plus 72 System and Stock bins and terminal state
native fixed mission and mission-time all/unit/type tables with exact additive numerators and denominators
negative group selector and positive group-owned A17 parent control, without asserting member-unit rollup
independent read-only replay without author validator imports
limitations: This is a bounded unit and mission-type reporting slice of J07.var05; group aggregation of member-unit missions is not established and the full planned variant remains open.
One seed, two deterministic concurrent two-hour fixed missions, no failures or support-resource competition.
Regenerative denominator exclusion, mid-mission partial outcome, GUI rendering and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
